audit_name: EXP-07 Cross-Domain Evaluation Epistemic Interpretation and Diagnostic Design Repair

tier_1_epistemic_downgrade.c18_overclaim: C18 stated that Tier 1 cross-evaluation would 'directly separate H1/H9 (dataset difficulty / domain shift) from H4/H7 (training optimization / class weights)'.
tier_1_epistemic_downgrade.c19_corrected_interpretation: Cross-domain evaluation is observational domain-transfer evidence, NOT causal identification. C8/C10 and C16 differ simultaneously in training dataset, sample count, cluster diversity, geographic distribution, and class weighting. Observing lower or higher cross-inference scores cannot mathematically isolate individual causal mechanisms.
valid_inferences: Inference 1: Does C16 generalize to OPS01 DEV tiles? (Measures reverse domain transfer)
Inference 2: Does C8/C10 generalize to OPS02 DEV tiles? (Measures forward domain transfer)
invalid_inferences: Claiming a low score on OPS02 DEV proves OPS02 is inherently unlearnable (confounded by capacity, architecture, and feature divergence)
Claiming a low score on OPS01 DEV proves C16 had optimization failure (confounded by feature suppression from extreme weighting)

tier_1.name: Zero-Compute Cross-Domain Evaluation
tier_1.compute_cost: 0 GPU training hours (< 2 minutes pure inference)
tier_1.data_evaluated: OPS-01 DEV (39 samples) and OPS-02 DEV (40 samples in OPS02_v1.0.1_FROZEN)
metrics_reported: Secondary: 12x12 confusion matrix, per-class IoU, tiered subgroup mIoUs
tier_1.epistemic_role: Provides exploratory transfer diagnostics to inform whether Tier 2 ablation is warranted.

tier_2.name: EXP07_DIAGNOSTIC_001 (Single-Variable Loss-Weighting Controlled Training)
tier_2.prerequisite: Execution conditional on explicit user approval and Tier 1 diagnostic results.
tier_2.independent_variable: Loss Weighting Scheme (Control: Sqrt-Median Frequency [0.403935 ... 18.243211] vs Treatment: Uniform Unweighted w_c = 1.0 for c >= 1, w_0 = 0.2)

constant_variables_locked_to_canonical_p.scheduler: LinearWarmupCosineAnnealingLR (3 warmup, 27 decay, total 30 epochs, min_lr = 1e-6)
constant_variables_locked_to_canonical_p.sampler: Candidate F Hybrid (70/30, 72 draws/epoch, replacement=True, seed_formula = base_seed + epoch * 1000)

tier_2.explicit_purging_of_c18_errors: The C18 table values (lr=3e-4, wd=1e-4, 20 epochs, accumulation=1, effective_bs=8) are PERMANENTLY PURGED. Any Tier 2 run must adhere 100% to the verified C15 canonical training protocol.
